title: Remove All Ones With Row and Column Flips II
summary: Given an m x n binary matrix, perform operations to change all cells in a chosen row and column to zero if they contain a 1.
statement: Given an m x n binary matrix, perform operations to change all cells in a chosen row and column to zero if they contain a 1. Determine the least number of operations required to eliminate all 1's.
constraints: In one operation choose a cell currently equal to one.
Set every cell in that chosen cell’s row and column to zero.
Return the minimum operations needed to remove every one.
hints: The grid is small enough to represent every remaining one as a bit mask.
An operation deterministically clears one full row and one full column; memoize the best result for each mask.
For every current one, clear its row and column in a copied mask and recurse with cost one.
Every legal first operation is tried, and the remaining problem depends only on the resulting mask, so the recurrence contains every possible operation sequence.
editorial: Every legal first operation is tried, and the remaining problem depends only on the resulting mask, so the recurrence contains every possible operation sequence.

tests.explanation: Choosing two well-placed one cells clears all rows and columns containing ones, so the minimum is 2.
No operation is needed when the grid already contains only zeros.
